subject: Request: Strategic pilot discount for Syntech AI (deep-discount request)
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@syntech.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Syntech AI Procurement <procurement@syntech.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — looking for deep discount to run US+EU pilot

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Syntech's engineering team liked Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching behavior looks promising for our summarization workloads. We're ready to start a pilot but I need to be candid: our procurement budget for pilots is tighter than expected.

We want a 3-month multi-region pilot (US + EU) with up to ~250M tokens/month (burst to 350M) at usage-based pricing. To make this work internally I need an as-delivered unit cost that's roughly 25% below your published hosted pricing.

I know that's outside standard concession ranges, so I'm opening the conversation early to understand what flexibility exists and what tradeoffs (commitment, prepay, SLA) you'd need. Attached a short MOU with our expected usage profile.

Can we lock on numbers this week? We have an internal exec review on Friday and would like Redwood's commercial position before then.

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Li
Head of Platform Partnerships, Syntech AI
karen.li@syntech.ai

Attachment: Syntech_MOU.pdf (1 page)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@syntech.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — looking for deep discount to run US+EU pilot

Hi Karen — great to hear the demo landed well. Appreciate the transparency on budget constraints.

We absolutely want to make a smooth path for Syntech to pilot Redwood in production-like conditions. I’ve looped in Ben (AE lead) and Marissa (pricing/deal desk) to explore options. A few quick questions to help the internal ask:

- Can Syntech commit to a 12-month consumption minimum if we provide the deeper unit rate?
- Is prepayment an option (partial or 100%)?
- Are you able to accept a slightly higher 99.5% SLO with a credit schedule instead of standard enterprise SLA?

If you can confirm commitment/prepay preference, we’ll surface a recommended concession and route for exec approval.

I’ll aim to get back with a clear concession range within 48 hours.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Syntech pilot — internal ask for >20% concession (background & recommended terms)

Marissa / Jonas —

Summary: Syntech (Platform) is asking for a ~25% reduction off list hosted usage rates for a 3-month multi-region pilot (250M tokens/mo nominal). They indicate a potential broader platform contract if pilot metrics hold. Vivek already shared the MOU.

Why consider?
- Strategic signal: Syntech is a rapidly growing platform partner with strong channel potential (partners+ISV marketplace).
- Multi-region test: if successful, they anticipate converting to a committed usage contract covering US/EU with minimums in Q4.
- Competitive motion: competitor X is offering lower introductory rates; losing pilot risks them selecting an alternative stack.

Proposal (what we can deliver if exec approves):
- Approved concession: up to 24% off published hosted per-token rates for the pilot period.
- Conditions: 12-month minimum total commitment (post-pilot) OR 50% prepayment on the pilot invoice.
- SLAs: move to 99.5% SLO for pilot; standard SLA reinstated if they convert.
- Legal: require a short addendum (pricing + usage commitment + auto-conversion clause).

Impact: Estimated ~$180k revenue deferral for Q3 but higher lifetime value if they convert. Pricing workbook attached.

Request: Jonas — need senior signoff for >20% concession (this would exceed Marissa's standard remit). If approved, Marissa / Legal can draft the addendum and I’ll move to finalize with Syntech.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: syntech_pricing_workbook_q3.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, FinanceOps <finance-ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syntech pilot — internal ask for >20% concession (background & recommended terms)

Ben / Marissa —

I reviewed the deck and the workbook. Syntech looks like a strategically defensible partner and the conversion motion is plausible. I’m willing to authorize a deeper-than-normal concession with conditions to protect revenue and margin.

Authorization (approved):
- Approve a 22% discount off published hosted per-token usage rates for the 3-month pilot only.
- Conditions:
  1) Syntech signs the pricing addendum (legal to prepare) that auto-converts pilot into a 12-month committed usage contract unless Syntech elects not to convert (with 60 days notice).
  2) Syntech provides 50% prepayment for the pilot invoice within 7 days of DocuSign completion.
  3) Finance will set a revenue deferral schedule (FinanceOps copied).
  4) Product to log feature/observability asks as part of the pilot onboarding checklist; we will not extend the same concession to other accounts without exec review.

Marissa — please prepare the addendum and coordinate with Legal and Finance. Ben / Vivek — present the final terms to Syntech and confirm acceptance.

Jonas
VP, Strategic Accounts
Jonas Weber
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Syntech pilot — internal ask for >20% concession (final)
